nativeBaseline.reference: native password input with native visibility button

library: Preserve native credential value and input identity while changing visibility.
Expose the authored action label (show or hide), not a contradictory pressed state; keep the action a non-submit button.
Framework visibility requests reconcile with the committed value; native disabled controls and cancelled actions do not change visibility.
consumer: Author show/hide labels, field label and password guidance; own authentication.

notes: Framework ports support default and controlled visibility; consumers author localized action names.
Web/Elements retain the native authored input type and form disabled semantics. Password-manager and manual AT observations remain required.
Audit mapping is provisional; not a conformance claim.
